name: button
description: The plain button primitive: themed variants (default, secondary, outline, ghost, destructive, link) and sizes (sm, md, lg, icon) over a native <button>, so it's keyboard- and screen-reader-accessible with a visible focus ring. For promise-aware actions, use async-button.

notes: A native <button> — focusable, Enter/Space activated and announced as a button with no extra wiring
Shows a visible focus-visible ring for keyboard users
disabled removes pointer events and is conveyed to assistive tech via the native attribute

intents: a plain button with style variants and sizes
primary / secondary / outline / ghost / destructive / link button
a link styled as a button via buttonClasses()
